hero.description: Zeonnex Group is a future-ready enterprise delivering excellence through three powerful divisions — IT & business solutions, interior design, and global import-export consulting & sourcing. One consultation, endless possibilities.

about.title: A Dynamic, Future-Ready Enterprise Delivering Excellence Across Industries
about.paragraphOne: Zeonnex Group brings together technology, design, and global trade under one roof. With a bold vision and unwavering commitment to quality, we lead in IT & business solutions, interior design, and international product sourcing — driven by trust, innovation, and impact.
about.paragraphTwo: Whether you're upgrading your business technology, designing a dream space, or sourcing products from verified global manufacturers — Zeonnex Group brings vision, value, and versatility to every partnership.

whyUs.description: From sourcing to delivery, from design to build — we manage every step with precision.

divisions.title: IT Products & Business Solutions
divisions.description: From enterprise hardware to smart office technology, Zeonnex Solutions equips businesses with reliable IT products and digital infrastructure that scale with you.

divisions.title: Interior Design & Turnkey Fit-outs
divisions.description: Zeonnex Interior crafts inspiring residential and commercial spaces — blending aesthetics, functionality and 3D visualization to bring your vision to life.

divisions.title: Import, Export Consulting & Sourcing
divisions.description: Your trusted link to global manufacturers. Zeonnex Hub delivers end-to-end sourcing, quality assurance and import-export consulting connecting China, India and the Middle East.

globalReach.title: Connecting China, India & the Middle East
globalReach.description: Zeonnex Group proudly bridges continents — linking top-tier manufacturers, growing markets, and ambitious businesses through seamless sourcing, consulting, and logistics. Together, we go further.
